window.scrollTo(0,0); if(!window.TallyHall)throw Error('App did not initialize'); 'Initialized'

if(!document.querySelector('#draft-form'))throw Error('Draft did not open'); if(TallyHall.Model.jobs(TallyHall.state).find(j=>j.id==='draft:a').status==='Done')throw Error('Unreviewed draft completed'); 'Draft requires review'

document.querySelector('#draft-reviewed').checked=true;document.querySelector('#draft-form').requestSubmit(); if(TallyHall.Model.jobs(TallyHall.state).find(j=>j.id==='draft:a').status!=='Done')throw Error('Draft not complete'); if(TallyHall.Model.balance(TallyHall.state,TallyHall.state.accounts[0])!==20000)throw Error('Draft altered balance'); 'Reviewed drafting only'

TallyHall.paymentModal('a','200'); document.querySelector('#payment-source').value='Checked bank row 37'; document.querySelector('#payment-verified').checked=true;document.querySelector('#payment-form').requestSubmit();if(TallyHall.Model.balance(TallyHall.state,TallyHall.state.accounts[0])!==0)throw Error('Balance did not settle');if(TallyHall.Model.jobs(TallyHall.state).find(j=>j.id==='collect:a').status!=='Done')throw Error('Collection not Done');'Payment updates all views'

const persisted=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('tallyhall.local.prototype.v1'));if(persisted.receipts.length!==6)throw Error('Payment did not persist'); TallyHall.navigate('tuition'); 'Local persistence verified'

TallyHall.openJob('approval:b');document.querySelector('#funding-approval').value='Approved';document.querySelector('#funding-submitted').checked=true;document.querySelector('#funding-source').value='Program confirmation 100';document.querySelector('#funding-form').requestSubmit();if(TallyHall.Model.jobs(TallyHall.state).find(j=>j.id==='approval:b').status!=='Done')throw Error('Approval not Done');if(TallyHall.Model.status(TallyHall.state,TallyHall.state.accounts[1])!=='Awaiting funding')throw Error('Funding treated as paid');'Approval and payment separate'

TallyHall.navigate('assistant');TallyHall.assistantAsk('Record $50 for Student D');if(!document.querySelector('.message-actions [data-action=payment]'))throw Error('Assistant action missing');'Assistant previews a mutation'

const file=new File(['student,amount,date,source,id\nStudent A,50.00,'+TallyHall.state.day+',Verified bank row 91,qa-import-1\n'],'qa.csv',{type:'text/csv'});const dt=new DataTransfer();dt.items.add(file);document.querySelector('#import-file').files=dt.files;document.querySelector('#import-file').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));

document.querySelector('#import-confirm').checked=true;document.querySelector('#apply-import').click();if(TallyHall.Model.balance(TallyHall.state,TallyHall.state.accounts[0])!==15000)throw Error('CSV import did not update balance'); 'CSV preview and confirmation verified'

TallyHall.accountModal('c');document.querySelector('[data-action=correct-receipt]').click();document.querySelector('#correct-amount').value='400';document.querySelector('#correct-reason').value='Checked original receipt';document.querySelector('#correct-form').requestSubmit();if(TallyHall.Model.balance(TallyHall.state,TallyHall.state.accounts[2])!==10000)throw Error('Correction failed');'Receipt correction reopens collection'

TallyHall.navigate('assistant');TallyHall.assistantAsk('Schedule follow-up for Student A tomorrow');const schedule=document.querySelector('[data-action=schedule]');if(!schedule)throw Error('No schedule preview');schedule.click();if(document.querySelector('#job-due').value!==TallyHall.Model.shift(TallyHall.state.day,1))throw Error('Incorrect proposed date');document.querySelector('#job-reason').value='School agreed next check';document.querySelector('#job-settings-form').requestSubmit();if(TallyHall.Model.jobs(TallyHall.state).find(j=>j.id==='draft:a').due!==TallyHall.Model.shift(TallyHall.state.day,1))throw Error('Date not saved');'Assistant date review updates shared job'
document.querySelector('#confirm-restore').click();if(TallyHall.state.receipts.length!==5)throw Error('Restore did not replace state');'Backup restoration reviewed and verified'

window.__recordsBefore=JSON.stringify(TallyHall.state);window.__networkCalls=0;window.fetch=()=>{window.__networkCalls++;throw Error('Unexpected network call')};window.__externalOpen=0;window.open=()=>{window.__externalOpen++;throw Error('Unexpected external page')};'Mock boundary armed'

if(document.querySelector('#page-tools').hidden)throw Error('Tools page hidden');if(document.querySelectorAll('[data-tool-card]').length!==4)throw Error('Missing providers');if(document.querySelector('#crumb').textContent!=='External tools')throw Error('Navigation missing');if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('Tools page overflow');'Four mock providers render'

if(document.querySelectorAll('#dialog input').length)throw Error('Mock requests credentials');if(!document.querySelector('#dialog-content').textContent.includes('not verified'))throw Error('Missing mock disclaimer');'No credentials requested'

if(!document.querySelector('[data-tool-card=brightwheel]').textContent.includes('Connected · demo'))throw Error('Missing demo state');if(JSON.stringify(TallyHall.state)!==window.__recordsBefore)throw Error('Tuition data changed');if(window.__networkCalls||window.__externalOpen)throw Error('External operation attempted');if(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('tallyhall.local.prototype.v1.demoConnections'))[0]!=='brightwheel')throw Error('Demo state not saved');'Demo connection is local and preserves records'

if(document.querySelector('[data-tool-card=brightwheel]').textContent.includes('Connected · demo'))throw Error('Disconnect failed');if(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('tallyhall.local.prototype.v1.demoConnections')).length)throw Error('Demo state not cleared');'Disconnect works'

for(const id of ['venmo','zelle','revolut']){document.querySelector('[data-tool='+id+']').click();document.querySelector('[data-action=tool-connect]').click();if(!document.querySelector('[data-tool-card='+id+']').textContent.includes('Connected · demo'))throw Error(id+' failed')}if(JSON.stringify(TallyHall.state)!==window.__recordsBefore)throw Error('Records changed');'All providers use the same safe mock flow'
